groups.name: File focus types and computation
groups.rationale: Introduces the three-state focus model and functions that derive how much attention each file needs from round history.
groups.watch: fileFocus returns 'new' for single-appearance files, but the condition fileHistory(rounds, path).length <= 1 counts a file not in any round as single-appearance too; roundFocus depends on the current round existing.

groups.name: Session rounds contract
groups.rationale: Makes rounds mandatory on SessionRecord instead of optional, and enforces this constraint by rejecting old session files that lack rounds.
groups.watch: Sessions written before rounds existed now fail to load, breaking backward compatibility; the parseSession error message suggests the file path incorrectly.

groups.name: Browser focus API
groups.rationale: Adds focus to SessionData so the browser can see which files need attention, populated server-side on each read.
groups.watch: Focus is derived fresh on every data read and never stored, so it could diverge from what was calculated during an end or re-group if the rounds changed between reads.

groups.name: Server focus derivation
groups.rationale: Computes and sends file focus for each session read, derived from its round history.
groups.watch: The comment claims focus is never stored and rounds are the truth, but if a session is modified between data reads, the focus sent could reflect a stale state of the rounds.

groups.name: Rounds field cleanup
groups.rationale: Removes optional chaining on rounds since it is now mandatory, simplifying null checks throughout.
groups.watch: All three removals of ?? [] assume rounds is always present; if any code path creates a SessionRecord without rounds, it will fail at runtime.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
